---
title: About this site
---

I began this site in September, 2026, after quarto.pub announced it would stop publishing new material

The blog posts here include a handful of notes from a personal site I previously maintained at [https://neelsmith.quarto.pub](https://neelsmith.quarto.pub). I've copied material from the quarto site about my work in Julia from 2020-2024 to a frozen site hosted on github pages at [https://neelsmith.github.io/juliawork/](https://neelsmith.github.io/juliawork).
